statement: If evidence is absent or ambiguous, block rather than approve. The gate re-reads disk ground truth and certifies from signatures + real provenance, never a seat's self-report.
No mutable label keys an enforcement decision; every enforcement identity is a content-derived address. A mutable label must not stand where an identity belongs.

statement: Nothing outside clotho/ may import from clotho/; each top-level package is self-contained. Slice diffs are confined to their declared paths.

Every real TELOS package prohibits runtime, development, optional, peer, bundled, build and test packages, dependency lockfiles, CDN application code and vendored library substitutes. Server/tooling code uses node: built-ins and repository-owned relative modules; the front end uses standard browser APIs. Declared Node/Git/OS/browser/CI platforms and licensed static assets remain prerequisites.

The Eye's approval of consequential, irreversible, self-improving, or authority-expanding action cannot be delegated to a model or inferred from silence. A model approval is not human authority; convergence is not authorization.
